name: contract-runtime-case-coverage
goal: Verification rejects missing, duplicate, skipped, orphaned or wrong-revision execution of registered cases

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Current case admission checks declarations only. A runner can report no executed registered cases while the declaration registry remains valid. Runtime case outcomes need exact file/title, revision and retry identity.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The existing validate case covers static files, duplicates and orphan declarations but no execution observations. Strengthened that same case for absent, duplicate, skipped, orphaned and stale outcomes while retaining both service cases.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: At8339707a33 the existing validate case fails because no executed-case observations produce no validation error. Immutable proof594a5903 preserves the two-case suite and exact missing-execution assertion.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Execution observations now validate exact file/title, nonnegative retry, revision, final passing outcome and declared scope. Focused unchanged suites pass four tests. Normal runner wiring remains a separate integration requirement.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
